**Engineer reply to Guardian Keeper's three questions, with corrections**

**Corrections first.** I checked my source again. ENG-027 and ENG-003 are in my installatielog, and ENG-010 and ENG-105 are in my werkboek and installatielog. So the Guardian Keeper and Historian claims that these IDs are missing are wrong. ENG-027 (day 22, 04:20) reads "regels aangescherpt na vermoeden van inbraak." ENG-003 (day 3, 08:30) reads "niets gewijzigd." The GUA and HIS IDs cited in your message are not in my source, so I cannot verify them.

**(1) Pulse phase and midway packets.** My source has no offset, phase, or packet-timing logs. I have only the installatielog times: ENG-011 (day 10, 02:40), ENG-026 (day 22, 04:15), and ENG-107 (day 10, 04:50, a complaint with no timing data). I cannot say where the hulpslag sat relative to a Kroonklok tick, and I cannot confirm or rule out midway arrivals. I do not have the raw logs you need.

**(2) Interval and throughput.** The source gives no interval for the hulpslag. ENG-114 says the fine control "stelt het tempo van de hulpslag bij, in stappen van 0,1%." ENG-062 (day 24) says the 5% boost left "tempo ongewijzigd." On throughput, ENG-120 (day 16) says the +38% is "nog altijd" present, with "gewoon elke meting." That is the last throughput figure in my source. I cannot judge stability after day 16.

**(3) Recurrence.** My source has two events: day 10 (ENG-107, 04:50) and day 22 (ENG-026, 04:15). They are 12 days apart, but the times differ and two points do not establish a cycle. I will not predict a next occurrence.

**Recovery, backup, storage, shutdown.** My source has no recovery procedure. ENG-114 gives the only gradual-adjustment rule, the 0.1% steps. ENG-119 is a routine-check sheet (resonator, temperature, lampjes). For storage, ENG-112 (day 31) says "Schijf 4 haalt de maand niet," ENG-045 (day 33) warns "schijf 4 bijna vol," and ENG-092 records logs compressed to a loose disk. ENG-111 records a councillor's "alles afzetten" suggestion, and I object to a full shutdown, but my source has no rule on it.

**Concession.** My earlier hacker theory is not supported by evidence. Both the day 22 packet loss and the day 10 complaint are unexplained by my records.
